evidence: Initializes the caller output to -1, follows a global mapping entry, reads a float at input-record +0x70, transforms its sign/exponent bits into a mapping index, obtains a nested attribute base, calls nested_attribute_value_or_zero with the supplied selector, converts that float result to signed int, and stores it to the output. No indexed callers are available; this name describes the visible lookup path without assigning field semantics (decompiled/main/main_0052.c:43507-43545; nested helper decompiled/main/main_0171.c:1253-1290).

Returns false unless the input byte at +0x3c9 is nonzero, then requires a sequence of helper checks to succeed, including a lookup through global address 0x7004650998, a helper with mode 4, and attribute_context_status_value_get selector 1 before calling a final record helper. Its two indexed callers branch on the boolean result; exact object/domain meaning is unresolved (decompiled/main/main_0056.c:16699-16743; callers decompiled/main/main_0056.c:16601-16602 and 17010-17011).

Checks the record byte at +0x5a8 and calls context_status_id_0x48_is_positive. When that predicate is false, it stores 0x400 at +0x584, conditionally copies +0x28 to +0x8, and clears byte +0x5a9; it then invokes a record helper and dispatches through the callback pointer at record +0x38, setting +0x5a9 when dispatch returns true. The name is limited to these visible updates and callback dispatch (decompiled/main/main_0031.c:6746-6778).

Returns a boolean after checking a state byte at a resolved object +0x22, validating a nested attribute provider via validate_nested_attribute_provider, resolving nested provider data, and checking its final byte at +0x126. The indexed caller is format_pitching_substitution_prompt and branches on the returned boolean for each candidate in the prompt sequence (decompiled/main/main_0105.c:44950-44994; caller decompiled/main/main_0108.c:34464-34468, 34538-34542, 34682-34686, 35485-35489).

Reads a signed 16-bit field at resolved record +0x9a and stores it through the caller-provided output pointer. It queries attribute_context_status_value_get with selector 0x13; only when the returned status equals 4 and an alternate record resolves does it replace the output with that record’s +0x9a value. No indexed callers are available (decompiled/main/main_0124.c:1008-1041; status helper decompiled/main/main_0124.c:1023-1028).
